_comment: Curated directory of PUBLIC-FACING webcam sources. Every entry is an official portal or a documented public API that publishes cameras intended for public viewing (traffic, transit, weather, scenic, wildlife, parks). No private/unsecured cameras. `providers` are wired into the live client-side adapters in js/providers.js; `directory` entries are browse-only links shown in the Sources panel.

providers.name: Transport for London — JamCams
providers.attribution: Powered by TfL Open Data. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights.
providers.notes: Open data. Works without a key at modest rates; a free key raises the limit. Still images + 9s video clips refreshed every ~3 min.

providers.name: Windy Webcams
providers.notes: The largest global public-webcam database, categorized (landscape, city, traffic, beach, harbor, mountain...). Free API key required (x-windy-api-key header). Best fetched via the build tool or a proxy because of the header + CORS.

providers.name: WSDOT Highway Cameras
providers.notes: Free access code (register once). Statewide traffic camera snapshots.

providers.name: US National Park Service Webcams
providers.attribution: Courtesy of the U.S. National Park Service
providers.notes: Free NPS Developer key (get one at api.nps.gov). Streaming and snapshot cams in national parks.

providers.name: Generic 511 / DOT camera feed
providers.attribution: Courtesy of the operating DOT / 511 service
providers.notes: A field-mapping adapter for any JSON/GeoJSON camera feed that exposes name + lat/lon + image URL. Point it at 511NY, 511GA, FL511, 511ON, Caltrans CCTV, DriveBC, NDW, etc. Most need a free per-service key.

directory.name: Windy.com Webcams
directory.notes: Browse 70k+ public webcams on a map.

directory.name: Skyline Webcams
directory.notes: Curated live public cams — cities, beaches, nature, wildlife.

directory.name: WebcamTaxi
directory.notes: Curated public live streams (mostly official YouTube feeds).

directory.name: EarthCam
directory.notes: Large network of public webcams in cities and landmarks.

directory.name: 511NY Cameras
directory.notes: NY State traffic cameras. Free developer key.

directory.name: Transport for NSW — Live Traffic
directory.notes: Sydney/NSW traffic cameras. Open Data API (free key).

directory.name: Rijkswaterstaat / NDW
directory.notes: Dutch national road authority open camera data.
